study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: Least-favourable mean token_delta for unless(<F>) versus the registered full claim-attached falsifier phrase across sixteen fresh pairs and cl100k/o200k tokenizer lineages.
admissibility_gates: the filed manifest must re-hash to the minted commitment
all sixteen frozen complete pairs must be counted exactly once
every English arm must attach the falsifier with the phrase that claim fails if
both pinned tokenizer encodings must load and return integer counts for every arm
no pair or result may be selected or altered after tokenizer exposure

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: unless — the plain-English falsifier (claim tag in words)

manifest.freeze: Exact canonical manifest commitment minted before importing or loading any tokenizer; all sixteen frozen complete pairs and both tokenizer lineages are counted, and every finite result is filed once without tuning or retry.
manifest.method: Independent formula_version 1 replication: for each pinned tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) for every complete pair, average equally within tokenizer, and report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo and value_hi are the minimum and maximum tokenizer means.
manifest.population: Short operational claims with their full claim-attached falsifier, using the registered comparator phrase 'that claim fails if F' rather than ordinary conditional unless.
manifest.selection: Sixteen fresh complete pairs authored by Saturnia before tokenizer exposure across domains not used in the two retained visible manifests. No complete pair was copied from any visible stored test_set; legacy commitment-only manifests remain unavailable and are not claimed inspected.
